judged_text: `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` is a no-op when destinationCalendar is null (organizer has no destinationCalendar and eventType has none), silently dropping the collected team destination calendars. A COLLECTIVE team event whose organizer lacks a destinationCalendar creates calendar events only via the default credential path while every teammate's destinationCalendar is discarded, so hosts' calendars miss the booking with no error surfaced.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);` which will not execute when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, silently dropping `teamDestinationCalendars`. Downstream, `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` only iterates destinations when `event.destinationCalendar && event.destinationCalendar.length > 0`; otherwise it falls back to the default-credential path, so those teammate destination calendars will indeed be ignored with no surfaced error. This matches the finding’s described broken behavior for COLLECTIVE events when the organizer lacks a destination calendar.
